title: 第11章 兽潮围城，偶遇林霜
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黑水城的清晨是被血腥气唤醒的。

苏余从土坯房中睁开眼，手已按在刀柄上。

窗外天色将明未明，灰蒙蒙的光里裹着浓重的铁锈味——不是一两个人的血，是成百上千生灵被撕碎后随风灌进城池的血腥。

他翻身而起，几步掠上房顶。

城墙上已乱成一锅粥。

守城的散修们衣衫不整地涌上城头，有人连法器都没拿稳就摔在了地上。

城下黑水河对岸，黑风岭的方向，山林在动——不是风过林梢的动，是整座山都在颤抖。

树木成片成片地倾倒，烟尘冲天而起，夹杂着妖兽嘶吼与树木断裂的巨响。

“兽潮！兽潮来了！”

“黑风岭的妖兽全疯了！全往这边冲过来了！”

苏余目光沉凝。

他从小在黑风岭打猎，从没见过兽潮。

他爹说过，上一次兽潮是六十年前的事，那一次黑水城死了七成人。

而这一次，山林颤动的幅度远比传说中更甚。

更让他在意的是兽潮来的方向——黑风岭最深处，鬼哭崖的方向。

识海中的时王碑微微震颤，那不是警告，是共鸣。

有什么东西在黑风岭深处苏醒了，正在搅动整座山脉的地脉灵气。

城墙上的散修们已经开火了。

符纸、火球、冰锥，乱七八糟地往城下砸。

城下的景象让人头皮发麻——黑风岭方向涌来的妖兽汇成一道洪流，冲在最前面的是铁甲犀和石牙野猪，体型大的像土坯房，小的也有磨盘大小。

它们赤红着双眼冲过黑水河，河水被踩踏得溅起丈高水花。

更远处，黑风岭上空盘旋着密密麻麻的黑影——那是铁爪鹫和赤瞳蝠，双翼展开遮天蔽日。

苏余按刀站在房顶，没有急着动手。

他在观察。

兽潮来得太突然，太整齐。

不同种类的妖兽平时互为天敌，此刻却像被什么东西驱赶着同时朝黑水城涌来。

那种感觉，就像有人在山里放了一把火，所有野兽都在逃命。

不是火。

黑风岭深处没有任何火光或浓烟。

是另一种东西——更古老、更深层的力量。

时王碑的震颤越来越强烈，苏余能感觉到识海中有什么信息正在浮现，但被一层无形的屏障挡住了。

那是苏玄恶念留在他记忆深处的信息，需要特定的时机才会解锁。

“放箭！放箭！”城墙上有人在喊。

苏余看见东区的把头——一个姓铁的炼气七层壮汉，正挥舞着一柄斩马刀指挥手下。

西区那边，一个穿铁甲的女人也在组织防御。

但妖兽太多，城墙上的散修就像站在洪流中的礁石，随时会被冲垮。

苏余深吸一口气，从房顶跃下，朝城墙方向奔去。

他不在乎黑水城的存亡。

但兽潮不挡住，所有人都得死。

而他需要活着——苏玄留下的信息还在识海中封存，他隐约感觉到，黑风岭深处的异动与他有关。

城墙上，铁把头正杀得双眼血红。

他一刀劈飞一只冲上城头的石牙野猪，回头看见苏余提刀走来，愣了一瞬：“你是哪个区的？”

“南城。”

苏余从腰间拔出淬毒长刀，“来帮忙。”

铁把头看着他手里那把刀——刀身隐隐泛着绿光，是淬了毒的百炼刀，品相不俗。

再看苏余的脸，年轻，苍白，但那双眼睛沉稳得像老猎人。

他没有多问，黑水城的散修大多互不相识，大难临头能来帮忙的就是兄弟。

“小子，会射箭吗？”

“会。”

铁把头从地上捡起一张被丢下的猎弓，又抓了把箭囊扔给苏余：“站那个垛口后面，专门射铁甲犀的眼睛。

别的地方射不穿。”

Page (1/3)

The morning in Blackwater City was awakened by the smell of blood.

Su Yu opened his eyes from the adobe house, his hand already pressed on the handle of the knife.

It was getting dark outside the window, and the gray light was filled with a strong smell of rust—not the blood of one or two people, but the blood of hundreds of thousands of creatures that were torn to pieces and then poured into the city by the wind.

He stood up and climbed to the roof in a few steps.

The city wall has become a mess.

The casual cultivators who were guarding the city rushed to the top of the city in disheveled clothes. Some of them fell to the ground without even holding their magic weapons firmly.

On the other side of the Heishui River below the city, in the direction of the Black Wind Ridge, the mountains and forests were moving—not the movement of the wind blowing through the forest tops, but the whole mountain trembling.

Trees fell in pieces, and smoke and dust rose into the sky, mixed with the roars of monsters and loud sounds of trees breaking.

"The beast tide! The beast tide is coming!"

"The monsters in Black Wind Ridge are all crazy! They are all rushing here!"

Su Yu's eyes were focused.

He has been hunting in Black Wind Ridge since he was a child and has never seen a tide of beasts.

His father said that the last beast wave was sixty years ago, and seventy people died in Blackwater City that time.

But this time, the tremors in the mountains and forests were far more severe than in the legend.

What concerned him even more was the direction from which the beast tide was coming—the direction from the deepest part of Black Wind Ridge to Guiwei Cliff.

The Shiwang Monument in the sea of ​​consciousness trembled slightly. It was not a warning, but a resonance.

Something has awakened deep in the Black Wind Ridge and is stirring the earth's aura throughout the mountain range.

The casual cultivators on the city wall had already opened fire.

Talismans, fireballs, and ice picks were thrown at the city in random directions.

The scene below the city was mind-numbing - the monster beasts coming from the direction of Black Wind Ridge formed a torrent, and the ones rushing at the front were the armored rhino and the stone-toothed wild boar. The big ones were like adobe houses, and the small ones were as big as millstones.

They rushed through the Blackwater River with red eyes, and the water was trampled so hard that water splashed high into the air.

Further away, dense black shadows hovered over Black Wind Ridge - they were iron-clawed vultures and red-eyed bats, their wings spread out to cover the sky and the sun.

Su Yu stood on the roof holding the knife, not in a hurry to take action.

He is observing.

The beast tide came too suddenly and too neatly.

Different types of monsters are usually natural enemies of each other, but now they seem to be driven by something and are rushing towards Blackwater City at the same time.

It felt like someone set a fire in the mountains and all the beasts were running for their lives.

Not fire.

There was no fire or smoke in the depths of Black Wind Ridge.

It's something else - an older, deeper power.

The tremors of the Shiwang Monument became more and more intense. Su Yu could feel that some information was emerging in the sea of ​​consciousness, but it was blocked by an invisible barrier.

That was the information that Su Xuan's evil thoughts left deep in his memory, and it would take a specific time to unlock it.

"Fire the arrow! Fire the arrow!" someone shouted on the wall.

Su Yu saw the leader of the East District, a strong man named Tie who was at the seventh level of Qi Refining, waving a sword to command his men.

Over in the West District, a woman wearing iron armor was also organizing a defense.

But there are too many monsters, and the casual cultivators on the city wall are like rocks standing in the torrent, and they will be washed away at any time.

Su Yu took a deep breath, jumped off the roof, and ran towards the city wall.

He doesn't care about the survival of Blackwater City.

But if the beast tide is not stopped, everyone will die.

And he needs to live - the information left by Su Xuan is still sealed in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, and he vaguely feels that the changes in the depths of Black Wind Ridge are related to him.

On the city wall, the iron head was killing people until his eyes were blood red.

He slashed away a stone-toothed wild boar that rushed to the top of the city. When he turned around and saw Su Yu approaching with a knife, he was stunned for a moment: "Which district are you from?"

"Nancheng."

Su Yu pulled out the poison-quenching sword from his waist and said, "Come and help."

The iron head looked at the knife in his hand - the blade was faintly glowing with green light, it was a poisoned Bailian Dao, and it was of good quality.

Looking at Su Yu's face again, he was young and pale, but his eyes were as steady as an old hunter's.

He didn't ask any more questions. Most of the casual cultivators in Blackwater City didn't know each other. The only people who could help in times of disaster were brothers.

"Boy, can you shoot arrows?"

"Yes."

Tie Baotou picked up a discarded hunting bow from the ground, grabbed a quiver and threw it to Su Yu: "Stand behind the crenel and shoot the armored rhino's eyes.

Can't penetrate other places."
